title: Basic content-box geometry
expectedBehavior: An absolutely positioned content-box includes padding and border outside its declared width and height.

title: Explicit border-box geometry
expectedBehavior: Padding and border remain inside an explicitly declared border-box size.

title: Viewport-root percentage sizing
expectedBehavior: Percentage offsets and dimensions resolve against the root containing block.

title: Nested absolute positioning
expectedBehavior: An absolute child uses the padding box of its positioned parent as its containing block.

title: Cascade specificity and source order
expectedBehavior: Type, class, ID, source order, compound selectors, and inline styles follow the CSS cascade.

title: Inherited text properties
expectedBehavior: A child inherits color and typography from its parent when it has no declaration of its own.

title: Normal block sibling flow
expectedBehavior: Block children start at the content edge and stack vertically in source order.

title: Inline-block run and display none
expectedBehavior: Inline-block siblings share a line and display:none contributes neither rendering nor layout space.

title: Multiline wrapping and pixel line height
expectedBehavior: Normal whitespace wraps at word boundaries and pixel line-height uses the resolved font size.

title: Preserved lines and centered text
expectedBehavior: Pre-line preserves explicit line breaks, collapses spaces, and centers each rendered line.

title: Flex row gap and centered alignment
expectedBehavior: A flex row centers its item group on the main axis, centers unequal item heights on the cross axis, and applies column gap once.

title: Flex column gap and end alignment
expectedBehavior: A flex column packs items at the main-axis end, aligns unequal widths at the cross-axis end, and applies row gap once.

title: Flex growth with gap
expectedBehavior: Flex growth distributes content-box free space by grow factor after reserving the main-axis gap exactly once.

title: Heading and paragraph browser defaults
expectedBehavior: Unstyled headings and paragraphs use centralized browser-like typography, auto block sizing, and vertical margins.

title: Unordered list flow and markers
expectedBehavior: List items stack at intrinsic line-box height inside the list content box and render outside disc markers.

title: Ordered list flow and markers
expectedBehavior: Ordered list items stack at intrinsic line-box height and render sequential decimal markers outside the content box.

title: Fixed table rows and columns
expectedBehavior: A fixed-size two-by-two table divides its border-free grid evenly across rows and columns.

title: Explicit table column widths
expectedBehavior: Fixed table columns honor explicit pixel widths instead of being redistributed equally.

title: Image intrinsic dimensions
expectedBehavior: An image without declared CSS dimensions uses the deterministic asset’s natural width and height.

title: Image object-fit contain
expectedBehavior: Contain preserves the image aspect ratio, centers it, and exposes the element background as letterboxing.

title: Image object-fit cover
expectedBehavior: Cover fills the image box while preserving aspect ratio and cropping equally from the long axis.

title: Explicitly styled button
expectedBehavior: An explicitly styled button uses the declared border box, background, border, radius, and centered label without relying on native browser chrome.

title: Explicitly styled text input
expectedBehavior: An explicitly styled text input uses the declared border box and renders its value with browser-like content insets.

title: Checked and disabled checkbox states
expectedBehavior: Explicitly styled checkboxes preserve independent width and height, initialize checked state visibly, and retain disabled opacity without invented labels.

title: Overlapping positioned siblings by z-index
expectedBehavior: A positioned sibling with the higher stylesheet z-index paints above a later DOM sibling throughout their overlap.

title: Minimum and maximum size constraints
expectedBehavior: Minimum constraints expand undersized boxes and maximum constraints shrink oversized boxes on both axes.

title: Letter and word spacing
expectedBehavior: Letter-spacing and word-spacing affect both painted glyph positions and the intrinsic width of an auto-sized inline box.

title: Inline flex outer and inner flow
expectedBehavior: Inline-flex containers participate in an inline formatting row while laying out their own children with flexbox.

title: Wrapped flex lines and align-content
expectedBehavior: Flex items wrap onto multiple rows, preserve row and column gaps, and distribute lines with align-content.

title: Negative and auto stacking inside a context
expectedBehavior: A negative z-index child paints above its stacking-context parent background but below a later auto-z sibling.

title: Styled semantic select control
expectedBehavior: A select element is recognized from its semantic type and paints its selected option at the declared content inset.

title: Text transform and right alignment
expectedBehavior: Text transformation affects measured and painted glyphs while right alignment uses the content box edge.

title: Universal selector cascade
expectedBehavior: The universal selector applies with zero specificity and remains overridden property-by-property by type and class rules.

title: Fixed positioning against the viewport
expectedBehavior: A fixed descendant is removed from normal flow and resolves its offsets against the viewport rather than its positioned ancestor.

title: Viewport-relative sizing and offsets
expectedBehavior: Viewport width and height units resolve against the rendered viewport for dimensions and positioned offsets.

title: Styled semantic textarea control
expectedBehavior: A textarea is recognized from its semantic type and renders authored line breaks from the declared content inset.

title: Relative offsets preserve block flow
expectedBehavior: A relatively positioned block is offset from its normal position while retaining its original space in sibling flow.

title: Flex order and individual alignment
expectedBehavior: Flex items paint in ascending order while align-self overrides the container cross-axis alignment for individual items.

title: Single-line text overflow ellipsis
expectedBehavior: No-wrap text that exceeds a fixed content box is clipped and replaced by an ellipsis at the same glyph boundary as the browser.

title: Font-relative sizing and offsets
expectedBehavior: Em lengths use the element font size while rem lengths use the 16px parity root for dimensions and positioned offsets.

title: Scoped descendant selectors
expectedBehavior: Descendant selectors match through multiple ancestors, remain scoped to the matching subtree, and combine the specificity of every compound.

title: Direct-child combinator scoping
expectedBehavior: A child combinator matches only an immediate child, not an otherwise identical element nested more deeply.

title: Adjacent-sibling combinator scoping
expectedBehavior: An adjacent-sibling combinator matches only the first matching element immediately following the left-hand sibling.

title: General-sibling combinator scoping
expectedBehavior: A general-sibling combinator matches every qualifying later sibling while excluding matching elements before the anchor.

title: First and last child pseudo-classes
expectedBehavior: The first-child and last-child pseudo-classes match authored sibling order and contribute class-level specificity.

title: Viewport-relative responsive geometry
expectedBehavior: Viewport-relative offsets and dimensions recompute against desktop, tablet, and mobile viewport profiles.

title: Width-based media conditions
expectedBehavior: Width media conditions participate in source order and select desktop, tablet, and mobile style variants at their matching breakpoints.

title: Semantic control state selectors
expectedBehavior: Enabled, disabled, and checked pseudo-classes match semantic control state and participate in the normal cascade.

title: Hidden overflow clips positioned descendants
expectedBehavior: A child extending beyond an overflow-hidden parent remains laid out at its authored size but paints only inside the parent clipping edge.

title: Child z-index remains inside parent stacking context
expectedBehavior: A high-z child inside a lower stacking context cannot paint above a sibling stacking context whose parent z-index is higher.

title: Explicit grid tracks with gaps
expectedBehavior: Grid children auto-place in row order, stretch into explicit px/fr columns and rows, and preserve independent row and column gaps.

title: Composed dashboard shell
expectedBehavior: A nested flex dashboard with sidebar controls, header typography and search, and a gapped card grid preserves browser geometry and paint.

title: Responsive composed card gallery
expectedBehavior: One gallery DOM adapts from three columns to two and then one while its flex shell and explicit row tracks follow each deterministic viewport.

title: Composed settings form
expectedBehavior: A settings panel composes labels, text and select controls, checked and disabled states, and right-aligned actions without renderer-specific layout adjustments.

title: Composed modal and backdrop
expectedBehavior: A fixed backdrop and modal paint above an application surface in z-index order while nested modal typography and actions retain their flex geometry.

title: Composed clipped popover menu
expectedBehavior: An anchored menu paints above application content, keeps its nested action layout, and clips consistently at an overflow-hidden shell boundary.

title: Composed article page
expectedBehavior: An article composes a flex metadata row, heading, sized image, and wrapped body copy with browser-equivalent geometry, line breaks, and paint.

title: Composed sidebar workspace
expectedBehavior: A fixed-width nested navigation and flexible workspace column preserve active-item styling, toolbar alignment, and content geometry.

title: Composed data table page
expectedBehavior: A semantic table with explicit columns and distinct header/body styling retains its row geometry inside a toolbar-based application page.

title: Composed checkout form
expectedBehavior: A semantic checkout form composes a positioned fieldset, mixed controls, aligned actions, and a flex order summary without renderer-specific structure.

title: Composed notification center
expectedBehavior: A compact toolbar and clipped stack of fixed-height notification rows preserve nested flex alignment, ellipsis, status styling, and the overflow boundary.

title: Mixed three-column grid tracks
expectedBehavior: Six items auto-place across two explicit rows with fixed and fractional columns plus independent row and column gaps.

title: Intersected nested overflow clips
expectedBehavior: A positioned descendant is clipped to the intersection of two overflow-hidden ancestor padding boxes.

title: Requirement and editability selectors
expectedBehavior: Required, optional, read-only, and read-write pseudo-classes match semantic input state and participate in cascade specificity.

title: Opacity stacking-context containment
expectedBehavior: Opacity creates a stacking context, so a high-z descendant remains below a root sibling with a higher stacking level.

title: Representative project management dashboard
expectedBehavior: A realistic project workspace reflows across desktop, tablet, and mobile while search editing, filtered application updates, and pointer/keyboard task toggling retain browser-equivalent state and events.

title: Representative data management application
expectedBehavior: A responsive inventory application preserves its data shell while search editing, page updates, and pointer/keyboard record actions retain browser-equivalent state and events.

title: Representative account settings application
expectedBehavior: A responsive account workspace preserves its form and modal layout while dialog dismissal, validation, editing, submit, and reset retain browser-equivalent state and events.

title: Content-sized block height
expectedBehavior: An auto-height block grows from in-flow children, collapsed sibling margins, padding, and borders while auto-width children fill its content box.

title: Wrapped text intrinsic height
expectedBehavior: A width-constrained block with auto height grows to contain every wrapped line plus its padding and borders.

title: Intrinsic text sizing in flex layout
expectedBehavior: Height-auto text flex items use their wrapped line-box height when justify-content positions the item group.

title: Max-width constrained intrinsic text height
expectedBehavior: An auto-height text block wraps and grows using its final max-width-constrained content box.

title: Content-sized input button
expectedBehavior: An appearance-none input button with auto dimensions sizes its border box from its label, line height, padding, and borders.

title: Content-sized non-text flex item
expectedBehavior: A non-text flex item contributes its descendant-driven auto height before its flex parent centers the item.

title: Nested flex padding and stretch
expectedBehavior: A padded flex container created as a flex item preserves its assigned used size while stretching an auto-sized child inside its content box.

title: Explicit grid tracks driving auto height
expectedBehavior: A height-auto grid contributes the sum of its explicit row tracks, row gaps, padding, and borders before its flex parent positions it.

title: Textarea rows driving auto height
expectedBehavior: A height-auto appearance-none textarea derives its border-box height from rows, line height, padding, and borders.

title: Row flex container intrinsic height
expectedBehavior: A nowrap row flex container with height auto uses the largest outer cross size of its in-flow items, plus its own padding and borders.

title: Column flex container intrinsic height
expectedBehavior: A height-auto nowrap column flex container sums its in-flow items, non-collapsing main-axis margins, gaps, padding, and borders.

title: Descendant styles during intrinsic pre-layout
expectedBehavior: Intrinsic pre-layout resolves child-combinator styles using the same complete DOM ancestry that is available during final element creation.

title: Three-value padding and margin shorthand
expectedBehavior: Intrinsic flex sizing expands three-value padding and margin shorthand as top, horizontal, and bottom values.

title: Flex shrink scaled by base size
expectedBehavior: Negative free space is distributed using each item flex-shrink factor multiplied by its flex base size.

title: Standalone flex container intrinsic height
expectedBehavior: A positioned height-auto flex container sizes its own border box from its in-flow children before laying them out.

title: Percentage flex item width from content box
expectedBehavior: A percentage width on a flex item resolves against the flex container content box, excluding its padding and borders.

title: Wrapped row flex intrinsic height
expectedBehavior: A height-auto wrapped row flex container sums its flex line cross sizes and row gaps, then adds its padding and borders.

title: Percentage grid track from content box
expectedBehavior: A percentage grid column resolves against the grid content box before column gaps are removed, and fractional tracks receive the remaining space.

title: Minmax grid tracks
expectedBehavior: A minmax pixel-to-fr track participates in fractional sizing but cannot shrink below its minimum.

title: Content-sized auto grid rows
expectedBehavior: Auto grid rows use the largest measurable item contribution in each row, and those rows plus gaps drive a height-auto grid container.

title: Auto grid row from nested flex content
expectedBehavior: An auto grid row and height-auto grid container use the intrinsic height of a nested flex item whose children are text-sized.

title: Responsive auto grid row from wrapped text
expectedBehavior: A Grid item is measured at its resolved column width, so responsive text wrapping drives the auto row and height-auto Grid container consistently.

title: Content-sized implicit grid rows
expectedBehavior: Items overflowing the explicit column structure create implicit auto rows whose heights use the largest item contribution in each row.

title: Fixed-count repeated grid tracks
expectedBehavior: A fixed-count repeat expands complete track functions before sizing and auto-placement, including repeated minmax columns and fixed rows.

title: Min-content and max-content grid rows
expectedBehavior: Non-spanning min-content and max-content rows use the largest measurable text contribution at the resolved column width and drive a height-auto Grid container.

title: Mixed fixed, intrinsic, and fractional grid rows
expectedBehavior: An indefinite-height Grid combines fixed and contribution-sized rows with content-sized fractional rows that retain their authored proportions.

title: Auto grid rows stretch in a definite height
expectedBehavior: Implicit auto rows first use their largest content contribution, then share remaining definite block-axis space equally under normal stretch alignment.

title: Intrinsic minmax grid rows
expectedBehavior: Height-auto Grid rows with min-content or auto minima and flexible maxima use measurable content bases while retaining their fractional proportions.

title: Auto grid row with nested application content
expectedBehavior: A height-auto Grid row recursively includes a nested Grid card containing wrapped block text, controls, and an explicitly sized image.

title: Reactive wrapped text update
expectedBehavior: Updating short text to wrapped text in the same render session grows auto-height ancestors and moves following content exactly as browser reflow does.

title: Delayed natural image in nested intrinsic containers
expectedBehavior: A delayed image without authored dimensions adopts its natural size, including padding and border, and reflows nested height-auto Flex and Grid ancestors plus following content.

title: Reactive control value and layout styles
expectedBehavior: Updating a visible textarea value and authored Flex direction, width, and height reflows the existing scene to the same result as a fresh render.

title: Reactive implicit Grid child list
expectedBehavior: Removing, reordering, relabeling, and adding Grid children reflows implicit rows in the existing scene without leaving the removed child behind.

title: Reactive image source replacement
expectedBehavior: Replacing a still-loading image source shows only the new image; completion of the older delayed source cannot overwrite the current element or grow scene resources.

title: Repeated resize and update lifecycle
expectedBehavior: Alternating desktop, tablet, and mobile resizes with short/long text updates remains identical to fresh rendering on every cycle and disposes all owned lifecycle state.

title: Pointer activation event order
expectedBehavior: A real primary-pointer activation targets the authored button and reports pointerdown, pointerup, and click once in browser order.

title: Focus and keyboard navigation
expectedBehavior: Pointer focus, forward and reverse Tab navigation, disabled-control skipping, and outside-click blur report the same focus and event order as the browser.

title: Text input editing events
expectedBehavior: Typing and deleting in a focused text input updates value and selection, emits input after each mutation, and commits change when focus leaves the control.

title: Textarea selection and multiline editing
expectedBehavior: Shift-arrow selection, selection replacement, newline insertion, continued multiline typing, and blur commit match a browser textarea.

title: Checkbox pointer activation
expectedBehavior: Each primary-pointer click toggles a checkbox before click listeners run, then emits input and change with the new checked state.

title: Radio group pointer activation
expectedBehavior: Clicking a different radio selects it and clears its group peer before click, while clicking the selected radio again emits no input or change.

title: Checkbox Space-key activation
expectedBehavior: Space on a focused checkbox reports keydown and keyup before a synthesized click, then emits input and change with the toggled checked state.

title: Radio group arrow-key navigation
expectedBehavior: Arrow keys move focus and exclusive selection within a named radio group, emitting input and change on the newly selected member before keyup.

title: Closed select keyboard selection
expectedBehavior: Arrow keys change a focused closed select immediately, skip disabled options, update its displayed value, and emit input then change before keyup.

title: Button keyboard activation
expectedBehavior: Enter synthesizes a button click during keydown, while Space synthesizes its click after keyup, with browser-compatible keyboard click details.

title: Explicit label control activation
expectedBehavior: Clicking an explicit label focuses and activates its associated checkbox through a synthesized control click with normal input and change events.

title: Form reset default action
expectedBehavior: A reset button emits click then reset and restores authored text and checked defaults without input or change events for the restored values.

title: Form submission default action
expectedBehavior: Pointer and Enter activation of a submit button emit click then submit on its containing form after edited text commits.

title: Required-field submission validation
expectedBehavior: Submitting an empty required field emits invalid and focuses it without submit; after entry, the same button emits submit.

title: Single-line implicit form submission
expectedBehavior: Enter in a focused single-line field synthesizes the form submit button click and submit while retaining field focus.

title: Authored hover-state paint
expectedBehavior: Pointer enter applies authored hover paint and pointer leave restores normal paint with browser-order boundary events.

title: Authored active-state paint
expectedBehavior: Primary pointer down applies authored active paint until pointer up, then restores normal paint and completes click.

title: Authored focus-state paint
expectedBehavior: Focusing a control applies authored focus paint and blurring it restores normal paint without changing geometry.

title: Text-control state across application update
expectedBehavior: A compatible stable-ID text input retains its user-edited value, focus, caret, and selection when an application update changes a sibling.

title: Choice-control state across application update
expectedBehavior: Stable compatible checkbox, radio, and select controls retain their live checked, selected, and focused state across unrelated updates and responsive reflow.

title: Removed and incompatible control cleanup
expectedBehavior: An incompatibly replaced or removed focused control loses its live state and focus, unregisters cleanly, and does not resurrect stale state when the authored ID is later reused.

title: Repeated interactive update lifecycle
expectedBehavior: Three equivalent text, select, checkbox, reset, update, and responsive cycles keep browser-equivalent state while resources and registrations plateau and final disposal cleans the scene.

title: Vertical wheel scrolling
expectedBehavior: Wheel input scrolls a fixed-height overflow:auto container, clamps at both ends, moves its content under a stable clip, and reports browser-equivalent scroll extents.

title: Horizontal wheel scrolling
expectedBehavior: Horizontal wheel input scrolls a fixed-width overflow:auto container, clamps at both ends, moves its row beneath a stable clip, and reports browser-equivalent scroll extents.

title: Nested wheel propagation
expectedBehavior: The nearest nested overflow container consumes wheel movement until it reaches a boundary, then further movement in that direction scrolls and clamps its overflow ancestor.

title: Scroll state across compatible updates
expectedBehavior: A stable unique scroll container preserves its offset through a compatible sibling update and clamps that offset when a later compatible update shortens its content.

title: Removed and incompatible scroll cleanup
expectedBehavior: A disabled, removed, or duplicate scroll-container identity leaves no live registry state, and later reuse of the ID starts from the authored zero offset rather than resurrecting stale state.

title: Pointer targeting after scrolling
expectedBehavior: A clipped control cannot be activated, becomes pointer-targetable and focusable after scrolling into view, and becomes inert again when scrolled back outside the clip.

title: Pointer caret placement
expectedBehavior: Clicking at different horizontal positions in a text input focuses it and places a collapsed caret at the nearest browser text boundary.

title: Bidirectional pointer drag selection
expectedBehavior: Forward and backward pointer drags expose ordered selection endpoints while retaining the active caret direction, and typing replaces each selected range with browser-equivalent events.

title: Single-line input caret autoscrolling
expectedBehavior: Keyboard and pointer caret movement keep a long single-line input caret visible by updating horizontal text scroll state, then return to the leading edge at Home.

title: Textarea caret autoscrolling
expectedBehavior: Moving the caret beyond a multiline textarea viewport scrolls vertically to keep it visible, preserves selection/editing state there, and returns to the leading viewport with the caret.

title: Textarea vertical keyboard navigation
expectedBehavior: ArrowUp and ArrowDown preserve the caret column across textarea lines; Shift extends from a stable anchor, scrolls the focus into view, and an unshifted arrow collapses the range directionally.

title: Textarea pointer drag beyond its viewport
expectedBehavior: Dragging a held pointer below a multiline textarea viewport extends the selection through off-screen lines while retaining the browser scroll offset before release.
